r:
For the NVMe device given, issues the Zone Management Send command with the "Open Zone" action. This will transition the zone to the opened state.

The <device> parameter is mandatory and may be either the NVMe character device (ex: /dev/nvme0), or a namespace block device (ex: /dev/nvme0n1).

<dl><dt data-o="">-n <NUM>, --namespace-id=<NUM></dt><dd>Use the provided namespace id for the command. If not provided, the namespace id of the block device will be used. If the command is issued to a non-block device, the parameter is required.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-s <lba>, --start-lba=<lba></dt><dd>The starting LBA of the zone to open.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-r, --zrwaa</dt><dd>Allocate Zone Random Write Area to zone</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-a, --select-all</dt><dd>Select all zones for this action</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-t <timeout>, --timeout=<timeout></dt><dd>Override default timeout value. In milliseconds.</dd></dl>

•Open the first zone on namespace 1: 
# nvme zns open-zone /dev/nvme0 -n 1 -s 0
